title: UneceProductCharacteristic
description: A prominent attribute or aspect of a product.

applicableCondition.description: A condition applicable to this product characteristic.

applicableCountry.description: A country applicable to this product characteristic.

applicableStandard.description: The referenced standard that is applicable to this product characteristic.

applicableSustainabilityCharacteristic.description: A sustainability characteristic applicable to this product characteristic.

contentTypeCode.description: A code specifying the content type of this product characteristic.

description.description: A textual description of this product characteristic.

identifier.description: A unique identifier for this product characteristic.

measurementMethodCode.description: A code specifying a measurement method for this product characteristic.

productCharacteristicValueCode.description: The code specifying the value of this product characteristic.

targetMarketDescription.description: A textual description of a target market for this product characteristic.

typeCode.description: A code specifying a type of product characteristic.

value.description: A value, expressed as text, for this product characteristic.

valueAmount.description: The value, expressed as an amount, for this product characteristic.

valueBinaryFile.description: The value for this product characteristic expressed in a binary file.

valueDateTime.description: The value for this product characteristic expressed as a date, time, date time, or other date time value.

valueIndicator.description: The value for this product characteristic expressed as an indicator.

valueMeasure.description: A measure of a value for this product characteristic.

valueMethod.description: A method specified for a value of this product characteristic.

valueNumeric.description: The value, expressed as a number, for this product characteristic.

valueParameter.description: A parameter specified for a value of this product characteristic.

valueRange.description: A range specified for a value of this product characteristic.

valueTolerance.description: A tolerance specified for a value of this product characteristic.
